title: aftergrid Finding manifest
description: The manifest.yaml of one Finding directory. Every data-bearing value shown to a Reader resolves through this file. Prose lives in memo.md; this file holds identities, bindings, policies and attestations. See docs/contracts/finding-manifest.md.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped when a field's meaning changes; check refuses unknown versions.

id.description: fnd_ plus 12 lowercase base-36 characters, minted once by `new finding`.

revision.description: Immutable once attested. A refresh, revisit or content change yields revision+1.

title.description: Display title. Not the Answer; not data-bearing.

state.description: Authoring state. draft: created by `new finding`, evidence may be incomplete. needs_input: paused on a named human input (see needs_input). complete: every required section, Claim and evidence reference is present; check can evaluate evidence validity. State is separate from outcome and from publication readiness.

outcome.description: What the Analysis concluded. pending only while state is draft or needs_input. insufficient_data, inconclusive and needs_reframing are valid complete outcomes.

generated_at.description: When this revision's content was last produced. Volatile: excluded from the content digest.

canonical_location.description: Where newer revisions can be found (repository path or URL). A downloaded render cannot discover supersession by itself; it points here.

needs_input.description: Present and non-empty only when state is needs_input. Each item names what is missing and who owns it. Never a placeholder answer.

owner.description: Person or role who can resolve it.

contact.description: Target of the Reader's single 'question or flag this' action. Rendered as a mailto and as copyable text.

profile.description: Id of a profile in the Instance readers file, or the reserved id `generic` for the Engine's fallback profile (schema/generic-reader-profile.yaml).

raw_ask.description: The ask as originally phrased. Kept verbatim.

state.description: resolved: decision, metric, population, window and falsifier are all sharpened. unresolved: sharpening incomplete; the missing parts are listed in unresolved. not_answerable: the Operator judged the ask cannot be answered as posed (needs_reframing Findings).

decision.description: The decision this Question informs, as a sentence.

primary_comparison.description: Pre-registered comparison, stated before any cuts. Exploratory cuts are labelled as such in Claims.

expected_outcome.description: Outcome the Check must produce for the Finding's Answer to still stand.

statement.description: Plain-language: what observation would show the Answer wrong.

owner.description: Who decides when or whether a falsifier can be written.

question.description: The sharpened ask. A fresh draft carries only id, raw_ask and state unresolved; a resolved Question carries every part and an executable falsifier.

kind.description: duckdb_file: an immutable DuckDB database. extract: a bounded table extract (CSV or Parquet) captured from a source.

method.description: How the input was captured, honestly: e.g. 'generator seed 42', 'REPEATABLE READ extract of 3 tables', 'manual CSV export, not a durable snapshot'.

inputs.description: Retained inputs. May be empty on a draft, on a needs_reframing Finding that ran no query, and on the recorded path (ADR 0010), where the harness ran every query and nothing was captured; an adapter-run execution must name existing inputs.

guarantees.description: Which guarantees this Finding holds. Empty means 'not reproducible' and the render says so. On the recorded path the list is exactly [artifact_replay]: the saved result can be replayed byte for byte, and nothing can be rerun or revisited until retained inputs exist.

drift_fingerprints.description: Optional drift signal over declared live dependencies. Never a reproducibility claim.

definitions.description: Every Metric definition or Diagnostic calculation this Finding cites, pinned by version and content hash.

lifecycle.description: Display only. Approval is the approval attestation, verified against the definition's own content hash.

path.description: Path relative to the Instance root.

content_hash.description: Hash of the definition content that was approved. Must equal the definition's content_hash for the approval to count.

role.description: decision_metric: headlines a Claim the Decision rests on; requires kind metric and a verified approval for publication. supporting: allowed with any lifecycle; status is shown.

executions.description: One record per query run. An execution, not a filename, identifies a result.

sql_hash.description: Hash of the SQL text as executed (after parameter binding templates, before binding values).

input_ids.description: The retained inputs this execution read. Empty only on the recorded path, where the harness reached the source itself and aftergrid retained nothing.

executed_at.description: When the query ran. Volatile: excluded from the content digest.

mode.description: capture: first run against the source while capturing inputs. retained_rerun: run against retained inputs. recorded: the harness ran it and `aftergrid record` pinned the SQL, parameters and result it produced (ADR 0010).

allOf.description: An adapter-run execution names the adapter, the Engine version that ran it and at least one retained input. A recorded one names none of them: aftergrid did not run it, will not say which engine did, and read no retained extract. The recorded branch is entered by `mode: recorded` as well as by `executed_by.kind: harness`, so the state /checked-analysis writes before the harness has run anything (mode: recorded, input_ids: [], no executed_by) is valid and `check` can report that the recording has not happened yet.

results.description: Saved result sets. Referenced by id from memo, tables, charts and derived values.

row_key.description: Column whose values are unique, stable row keys. References resolve by key, never by index.

definition_ref.description: Definition this column's values are computed under, when it is a metric or diagnostic value.

provisional.description: True when any input was read under provisional access. Provisional results cannot be rendered for a Reader; the status propagates to derived values.

derived.description: Renderer-side derivations. Prefer SQL; use these only for display-time arithmetic over referenced operands.

operation.description: difference: a-b. ratio: a/b. percent_of: 100*a/b. percent_change: 100*(a-b)/b. sum: a+b+... min/max: smallest/largest operand (identical units). Operand order is positional, or declared by name: difference accepts { after, baseline } or { minuend, subtrahend }, ratio accepts { after, baseline } or { numerator, denominator }, and percent_change accepts { after, baseline } only, because a percent change without a baseline is not one. Their sign depends on which operand is which and both orders are valid arithmetic, so a named form is what makes the direction checkable; the positional form is reported as `direction_unstated`.

operands.description: A positional list, or one named pair: { after, baseline } for a before-and-after comparison (difference, ratio, percent_change), { minuend, subtrahend } for a subtraction that is not a comparison (difference), { numerator, denominator } for a division that is not a comparison (ratio). Each named form is a declaration of order and each clears `direction_unstated`. Keys from two vocabularies cannot be mixed, and a named pair on an operation that does not accept it is refused (`derived_arity`).

on_zero_denominator.description: Only defined behaviour: render as not available, never 0 or infinity.

on_null.description: Any null operand yields not available.

external_sources.description: Typed values that do not come from a query: targets, assumptions, external references. Each names where it came from.

spec_path.description: Vega-Lite spec in the validated subset. Data is bound by the renderer from result_id; the spec carries no data.

title.description: States the Claim. May contain reference tokens.

description.description: Meaningful text alternative for the chart: what it shows and the takeaway. May contain reference tokens.

variant_of.description: Set on rejected Variants kept for the record; only charts without variant_of render.

row_keys.description: Optional subset and order of rows to show. Absent: all rows in saved order.

required.description: Required Checks must pass for evidence validity. Never true on a `kind: falsifier` Check: a falsifier is not an evidence-validity condition, it decides the Finding's outcome. `check` refuses `required: true` on a falsifier with `check_shape` (docs/contracts/checks-and-results.md).

outcome.description: Last recorded outcome. Artifact-verification mode reports not_run for SQL Checks it did not execute; it never reports pass on their behalf. When `reported_by` is present the outcome is the harness's word, not the Engine's, and a `pass` needs `reported_by.evidence`.

executed_at.description: When the Check ran. Volatile: excluded from the content digest.

expected_outcome.description: Only for kind falsifier; mirrors question.falsifier.expected_outcome. A recorded outcome that differs from it is the falsifier firing: the Finding's outcome is then inconclusive or needs_reframing, never answered.

reviews.description: Agent review records. They complete a draft; they are not publication approval.

reviewer.description: Agent or person identifier plus model id where applicable.

content_digest.description: Digest reviewed. A review whose digest differs from content_digest is stale.

profile.description: For reader reviews: the profile id adopted.

attestations.description: Human attestations bound to content_digest. Publication requires a current publication_approval whose source verifies against trusted Instance policy. Hashes prove binding, not identity; identity is verified at the source.

attester.description: Display value only. The trusted identity is the one the source verifies.

granularity.description: row_level is never allowed in a Reader render in v0; the field exists so the refusal is explicit.

allowed_fields.description: Result columns that may appear in the Reader payload, including hidden chart data. Anything not listed is projected out.

private_marker.description: A sentinel string placed in private-only content; the render test asserts it is absent from HTML, SVG and embedded payloads.

counter_metrics_reported.description: What this Finding reports for each counter-metric its published decision metric's definition names (docs/contracts/instance-layout.md). Optional and omitted when empty, so a manifest written before counter-metrics existed is unchanged. Whether every listed counter-metric is covered, and whether the window is the Question's, is check's job: docs/contracts/finding-manifest.md.

id.description: The counter-metric definition's id. Must also be pinned in definitions[] at this version.

ref.description: The traced value reported for this counter-metric. Resolved through the same strict resolver render uses, so it is hashed, allowlisted and displayable.

window.description: The period the reported value covers. Required with `ref`, and checked field for field against question.window.

not_computed.description: One sentence: why this counter-metric could not be computed. An explicit, reviewable absence, never a way past the rule. At least one non-whitespace character: a blank reason is the silence the rule exists to refuse, spelled with a space.

description.description: Plain words: what data this Finding covers and what it does not.

version.description: Pinned renderer version. Part of the content digest.

content_digest.description: Digest over the envelope defined in docs/contracts/finding-manifest.md. Excludes itself, attestations, reviews, generated outputs and volatile timestamps.

id.description: Restricted id charset: lowercase, digits, underscore. No dots or hyphens so reference separators are unambiguous.

row_key.description: Row key value. Hyphens allowed (dates, slugs); dots are not.

relpath.description: Path relative to the Finding directory unless stated otherwise. No absolute paths, no parent traversal.

unit.description: Business unit from evidence or definition metadata, never inferred from SQL type. unknown is allowed and rendered as such.

display.description: Defined once per column or derived value; applied only at display, never before a derived calculation. A percent display of a ratio column multiplies by 100 at display.

definition_ref.description: A definition reference always pins a version; the manifest's definitions list carries the content hash.

value_ref.description: A reference without the {{ }} wrapper: ref:<result>.<row_key>.<column>, derived:<id>, or ext:<id>. Same grammar as memo tokens.

commit_sha.description: Exact analyzed commit. The review must be APPROVED, current and not dismissed at this SHA, by a login on the Instance's trusted allowlist. Verified through the API, never from this file alone.

oneOf.description: A note with no trusted source. Never counts toward publication readiness; kept so that a forged or informal approval is visible and rejected, not hidden.

subject.description: The value the proposition is about.

operator.description: within/outside compare subject to baseline +/- tolerance.

threshold.description: A number, or a value_ref when the threshold is itself evidence (e.g. a baseline or an external target).

oneOf.description: Versioned reference to a method described in the Instance.

baseline.description: Required when the predicate uses within/outside.

minimum_data.description: Below this the Recheck reports insufficient data rather than a result.

window_policy.description: fixed_window: restate the same dates on refreshed data. advancing_window: shift the whole fixed-length window forward so its end is the new data_to. expanding_window: keep the start, extend the end to the new data_to (an accumulating observation window).

coverage.description: Plain words: what the retained inputs must still cover for the comparison to apply.

not_comparable_when.description: Conditions under which the Recheck reports not comparable (definition or population change, method assumptions no longer hold).

owner.description: Who re-judges this Claim on Revisit.

review_hint.description: What a human should look at when re-judging.

sentence.description: The Claim as one sentence; the Evidence subsection heading. May contain reference tokens.

numeric.description: True when the Claim asserts a number. Numeric Claims require at least one chart or table and at least one evidence reference.

evidence.description: Every value the Claim rests on. Empty only for non-numeric Claims.

population.description: Who is counted, in plain words.

description.description: Compared with what, in plain words. For kind none: why no comparison is made.

pre_registered.description: Whether this comparison was the Question's primary comparison. Exploratory comparisons are labelled as such in the render.

exclusions.description: Who or what was left out, each as a sentence. Empty array means nothing excluded; say so in the memo.

material_caveat.description: The one caveat that would change the conclusion, shown next to the Answer. Required on the Claim the Answer rests on.

answer_bearing.description: True for the Claim(s) the Answer sentence rests on.

provisional.description: Rests on provisional evidence; cannot be rendered for a Reader.

executed_by.description: Who executed this query. `harness`: the Operator's own tool ran it and `aftergrid record` wrote down the SQL, the parameters and the result file the tool produced, without running anything (ADR 0010, docs/contracts/record.md). `adapter`: an aftergrid adapter ran it against the retained inputs and the Engine observed the result — `aftergrid execute` does not write this field today, because `adapter`, `engine_version` and `mode: retained_rerun` already say so, and the value exists so it can start without a schema change. Absent therefore means an adapter run, and is never read as `harness`.

tool.description: The tool that actually ran the SQL, as the Operator names it (`psql`, `supabase mcp`, `duckdb cli`). It is a record of what the harness used, never a claim about what aftergrid did.

tool_version.description: The tool's own version, when the Operator states one. Never invented.

recorded_at.description: When aftergrid wrote this record down. Volatile: excluded from the content digest. When the tool ran is executions[].executed_at.

reported_by.description: Present when this Check's outcome was reported by the harness rather than executed by the Engine (ADR 0010). An agent-reported outcome is never a mechanical one: `check` treats it as valid only for artifact consistency, publication readiness is `unknown` at most, and the render says the Operator's tool ran it.

tool.description: The tool that ran the Check, as the Operator names it.

reported_at.description: When aftergrid wrote the reported outcome down. Volatile: excluded from the content digest.

evidence.description: The artifact the harness produced when it ran the Check, copied into the Finding and pinned by hash. Required for outcome `pass`: `aftergrid record` refuses an agent-reported pass with nothing behind it, and `check` reports `unevidenced_outcome` when a manifest carries one.
